title: Record the source value copied into register 262
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 16152, register 360 holds `1/2` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `-2` and writes `-1` into register 262, which is `0` until then.
- Register 360 is `1` after event 9564 and `1/2` after event 11810. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
